description: Provincial Public Service Commission - Western Province - The Provincial Councils Act. No. 42 of 1987 Order ruder Section 32(2a)
categorisation: This gazette notification amends the delegation of powers for public service matters (transfers, dismissals, disciplinary control) within the Western Provincial Public Service. It deals specifically with public sector administration, service conditions, and personnel management for provincial government officers, falling under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8). While it mentions government officials (Secretary, Commissioner), it does not focus on government structural changes or individual appointments with portfolio responsibilities, but rather on administrative procedures for public servants.
